TLMC374.DegreeAtMostTwo (z : ℂ) : Prop
TLMC374.IsPrimitiveMinimalPolynomial (z : ℂ) (p : Polynomial ℤ) : Prop
TLMC374.primitiveMinpoly_scalar {z : ℂ} (hz : IsAlgebraic ℚ z) :

TLMC374.degreeAtMostTwo_real_iff (x : ℝ) : TLMC374.DegreeAtMostTwo ↑x ↔ IsAlgebraic ℚ x ∧ (minpoly ℚ x).natDegree ≤ 2

TLMC374.source_conjunct_false (d : TLMC374.ApproximationDomain) (c : TLMC374.HeightConvention) :

def TLMC374.approximants : (ℂ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ :=
fun H ξ τ => {z | TLMC374.DegreeAtMostTwo z ∧ ‖↑ξ - z‖ < H z ^ (-τ)}
def TLMC374.Pcomplex : (ℂ → ℝ) → ℝ → Set ℝ :=
fun H τ => {ξ | (TLMC374.approximants H ξ τ).Infinite}
def TLMC374.Preal : (ℂ → ℝ) → ℝ → Set ℝ :=
fun H τ => {ξ | {z | TLMC374.DegreeAtMostTwo ↑z ∧ |ξ - z| < H ↑z ^ (-τ)}.Infinite}
def TLMC374.P : TLMC374.ApproximationDomain → TLMC374.HeightConvention → ℝ → Set ℝ :=
fun d c τ =>
  match d with
  | TLMC374.ApproximationDomain.real => TLMC374.Preal (TLMC374.standardHeight c) τ
  | TLMC374.ApproximationDomain.complex => TLMC374.Pcomplex (TLMC374.standardHeight c) τ
def TLMC374.standardHeight : TLMC374.HeightConvention → ℂ → ℝ :=
fun x =>
  match (motive := TLMC374.HeightConvention → ℂ → ℝ) x with
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.naive => TLMC374.naiveHeight
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.mahler => TLMC374.mahlerHeight
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.absoluteWeil => TLMC374.absoluteWeilHeight
def TLMC374.polynomialHeight : TLMC374.HeightConvention → Polynomial ℤ → ℝ :=
fun x x_1 =>
  match x, x_1 with
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.naive, p => ↑(TLMC374.naivePolynomialHeight p)
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.mahler, p => HeightRoots.mahler p
  | TLMC374.HeightConvention.absoluteWeil, p => HeightRoots.weil p
def TLMC374.naivePolynomialHeight : Polynomial ℤ → ℕ :=
fun p => p.support.sup fun i => (p.coeff i).natAbs
def HeightRoots.mahler : Polynomial ℤ → ℝ :=
fun p => |↑p.leadingCoeff| * (Multiset.map (fun z => max 1 ‖z‖) (HeightRoots.complexPolynomial p).roots).prod
def HeightRoots.weil : Polynomial ℤ → ℝ :=
fun p => HeightRoots.mahler p ^ (1 / ↑p.natDegree)
